title: Cybersecurity as Part of Core Curriculum in Primary Schools
what_it_is: Cybersecurity as Part of Core Curriculum in Primary Schools

sections.label: Cybersecurity in CCE lessons
sections.summary: Cybersecurity education is delivered in Cyber Wellness lessons within the Character and Citizenship Education curriculum, teaching primary students to identify dangerous online content.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Cybersecurity education is delivered as part of Cyber Wellness lessons within the Character and Citizenship Education (CCE) curriculum.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: As part of CCE, all primary students are taught how to keep themselves safe in the online environment, including how to identify dangerous online content like phishing emails and online falsehoods.

sections.label: Cybersecurity in Code for Fun
sections.summary: A cybersecurity module is incorporated into the Code for Fun programme for all upper primary students, covering encryption and protection against cyberattacks.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: A cybersecurity module is also incorporated into the Code for Fun programme for all upper primary students, where they are exposed to concepts like encryption and ways to protect oneself against cyberattacks.

sections.label: MOE to consider compulsory cybersecurity
sections.summary: MOE will consider making cybersecurity compulsory and will study the point further, while being conscious of not overloading the curriculum.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: As to whether or not to make it compulsory, this is something that MOE will consider.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: We are also conscious that we do not want to overload the curriculum because we have to pay attention to the learning needs of the students.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: But I think the Member has made a valid point and this is something that MOE will study further.
